text:
Alex Chen: Throwing out a proposal: standard remediation card for postmortems (7/30/90) + a weekly "remediation radar" to catch overdue items.

Alex Chen: Quick card fields idea: Owner / Backup / Priority / ETA(7/30/90) / Owner SLA (48h ack) / Verification (smoke/perf/canary + tester) / Rollback plan / Observability changes / Recurrence tag / Blocked-by / Status

Samira Patel: Add a short testing checklist in Verification and a clear "Done criteria". Also please include a date for verification complete. :+1:

Priya Nair: I'll add observability change examples (dashboards, alert thresholds) and a tiny script to tag incidents with recurrence flags if the same RCA shows up 3x in 90 days.

Jordan Lee: Comms cadence suggestion: internal follow-up summary within 48h, product-team note within 48h, public status page update within 72h for customer-facing outages, and a weekly internal remediation digest. I'll write copy templates.

Maya Ortiz: IC rotation note: prefer 6-week rotations with a 4-day overlap for handoff. Handoff checklist: access, active runbooks, recent incidents, open remediations, and a pairing session on first overlap day.

Alex Chen: Volunteers? Samira for the remediation card + test checklist; Priya for observability + recurrence script; Jordan for comms templates; Maya for rotation schedule & handoff checklist. I'll glue into one playbook draft.

incident-bot: Created doc: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/remediation-card-v1 (edit: eng-oncall)

Samira Patel: I'll push a first draft by Thu EOD.

Priya Nair: I'll prototype the recurrence tagger and add examples in the doc this week.

Jordan Lee: Comms snippets will be short and copy-ready, dropping in the playbook by Fri.

Maya Ortiz: I'll publish the rotation calendar and onboarding checklist after Samira's draft is in.

Alex Chen: Plan: pilot the card on next postmortem and surface overdue items via the weekly remediation radar. Thanks all :raised_hands:
